commit.message:
Make Bazel release jobs advisory (#52299)

## Why

Parallel Bazel artifacts are advisory while Cargo remains the release path.

## What changed

- Set `continue-on-error` for Bazel matrix jobs covering builds, Windows symbols and signing, and macOS signing, packaging, and verification.
- Assign the main release build jobs in both workflows to the `bazel` environment with `deployment: false`.

GitOrigin-RevId: e8a0fd522ec6482c0f39abdfc8677018be409361

Emit one developer notice per incremental namespace update batch (#52295)

## What changed

Move incremental tool guidance out of namespace descriptions and into a developer message preceding each namespace declaration batch after the initial catalog. The notice covers newly added namespaces as well as changed ones, explaining that earlier tools remain available unless explicitly removed and that newer definitions replace earlier ones.

Retain the notice alongside tool declarations in full-history agent forks, and discard it when legacy compaction forks rebuild those declarations.

## Testing

Add unit coverage for multiple new namespaces sharing one notice. Update request-history snapshots for tool changes, removals and restoration, and regular Responses requests. Extend resume and fork tests to cover notice preservation without duplication and removal when rebuilding declarations.

GitOrigin-RevId: 05f79f5eb378a355cf935eabf63951015a9b454b

Remove duplicate field initializers from extension registry tests (#52288)

Remove the repeated `selected_capability_roots` initializers from the two
`TurnEnvironmentSelection` fixtures in
`mcp_context_preserves_selected_executor_order_and_unavailability` so the
test can compile.

GitOrigin-RevId: 6e773cdcba84b95220eb024d51619fea67780617

Honor custom OTLP metrics exporters when analytics is disabled (#52278)

## Why

Disabling OpenAI analytics also disabled explicitly configured OTLP metrics collectors. Users should be able to export metrics to their own collectors independently of `analytics.enabled`.

## What changed

Apply the analytics preference only to the built-in `statsig` metrics exporter. Keep custom OTLP HTTP and gRPC exporters enabled regardless of that preference, and use `otel.metrics_exporter = "none"` to disable metrics export. Clarify these settings in config documentation and the schema.

## Testing

Cover exporter selection across explicit and default analytics preferences. Update app-server and daemon telemetry tests to verify custom metrics export with analytics disabled, and worktree tests to disable metrics through the exporter setting.

GitOrigin-RevId: 0c61f0f01e2b694db642ac7e7fd1dac9965c7d96

Preserve UTF-8 byte semantics in network domain matching (#52277)

## Why

Domain wildcards need to retain the byte-based behavior of `globset`. Counting Unicode scalar values changes how `?` matches non-ASCII hosts.

## What changed

Match domain patterns against UTF-8 bytes so `?` consumes exactly one byte. For example, `api??.com` matches `apié.com`. Match hosts through borrowed byte slices, avoiding the per-match character-vector allocation.

Document ASCII case insensitivity and the absence of IDNA conversion: hosts supplied as Punycode require patterns using their Punycode spelling.

## Testing

Compare Unicode wildcard cases against `globset` for both allowlists and denylists, including multibyte characters, combining marks, Punycode, and case sensitivity. Update the exhaustive dynamic-programming comparison and retry-boundary tests to operate on bytes.

GitOrigin-RevId: fae5b3b1ae60b469cd61a44c5c6e245730adc8ba

Add structured tracing for Guardian reviews and background scoring (#52274)

## What changed

- Add debug spans with review, thread, turn, and tool-call identifiers to correlate approval reviews and background scoring.
- Log review retry scheduling with failure details, attempt limits, backoff, and remaining deadline budget.
- Emit warnings for Guardian V2 background scoring failures with the failure reason, context mode, and duration, even when metrics are unavailable.

GitOrigin-RevId: 3e20d16836576f834998af473815bfb55e671de5

Add configurable persistent leader shortcuts to the TUI (#52273)

## What changed

- Add `tui.keymap.global.leader`, defaulting to `ctrl-x`, and symbolic bindings such as `leader c` that follow the configured prefix. The default prefix yields to existing custom shortcuts and chord prefixes.
- Keep leader shortcut hints open until completion or cancellation, while ordinary chords retain their one-second timeout. Pressing `esc` or repeating the leader cancels the pending shortcut.
- Add leader configuration and a `Use leader...` capture option to `/keymap`, with resolved shortcut labels and conflict validation.
- Cancel pending chords when input targets change, on paste or focus loss, and on mouse actions other than movement.
- Move the default voice mute shortcut from `ctrl-x` to `f9` and update its tests and displayed hints.

GitOrigin-RevId: 35b964cccd2812c73200f0c26b0f19506821df92

Enable text selection in the fullscreen TUI footer (#52270)

## What changed

Allow mouse selection and plain-text copying of rendered status and footer text, honoring `tui.copy_on_select` and existing selection keyboard controls. Keep the selected region stable while other content updates, preserve Unicode and terminal hyperlinks, and clear selections when their region becomes invalid.

Defer warning clicks until a stationary mouse release so dragging selects text without opening the warning viewer. Preserve the composer draft and cursor while selecting footer text.

## Testing

Add unit and snapshot coverage for visible-text copying, Unicode and hyperlinks, selection invalidation, keyboard ownership, and stationary clicks versus drags. Add a fullscreen integration test for warning selection and draft preservation.

GitOrigin-RevId: dd14d7ede52e97e507be24c4d6ac0299f7388a9b

Preserve large arguments in executed tool call metadata (#52268)

## Why

Fixed argument limits truncated recorded tool calls even when their metadata fit within the available message budget.

## What changed

- Remove the 8 KiB per-call and 32 KiB per-output argument limits for direct calls and Code Mode.
- Preserve full recorded arguments while retaining message metadata budgets, pending-call limits, and the direct metadata retention limit.
- Rename the normalization helper to `normalize_executed_tool_call_completeness`; it now only clears completeness when calls or tool names were lost.

## Testing

Update regression coverage for large arguments, escaped inputs, reserved-key wrappers, and argument and result metadata preservation across Code Mode waits.

GitOrigin-RevId: 8c199ccf39191d5d44eef02d28b1773654735b43

Normalize formatting in docs, web assets, and sample scripts (#52256)

## What changed

- Reformat Markdown tables and lists, login pages, inline visualization HTML, and sample JavaScript scripts.
- Escape union-type pipes in Python SDK API tables so they render within their cells.
- Keep the formatting-recipe test focused on the working directory and formatter commands by removing assertions on comment text.

GitOrigin-RevId: ae46d5b40fd013553de8b5ccf2c41d76be65aba8

Add opt-in Guardian trust for orchestrator connector identities (#52250)

## What changed

Add the disabled-by-default `guardian_trust_orchestrator_connectors` feature flag. When enabled, Guardian V2 accepts connectors with nonblank IDs from the host-owned plugin service orchestrator as a trusted source without requiring a matching user configuration declaration.

Distinguish orchestrator provenance from user configuration in trusted-tool context. Trust remains scoped to the exact server or connector identity and source; descriptions, outputs, other tools, and other connectors remain untrusted.

## Testing

Add coverage for host-owned connector context, rejection of extension-owned Apps lookalikes and blank connector IDs, source-specific trust metadata, and context token limits. Snapshot the connector approval request history.

GitOrigin-RevId: fbd87dd71110ca7b2b92d50eef02e1e739a74a02

Enable parallel execution for read-only tools (#52245)

## Why

Tools that do not opt into parallel execution acquire an exclusive scheduler lock, serializing independent reads.

## What changed

Allow skill listing and reading, memory listing, reading and searching, conversation history search and reading, plugin listing, agent listing, current time, remaining context, and `get_goal` to run in parallel. Keep goal creation and updates serialized.

## Testing

Add `cloud_skill_reads_run_in_parallel`, which uses a barrier to require two cloud skill reads to overlap and verifies that each returns the expected resource contents.

GitOrigin-RevId: 97b5634f1f84be2ba092be89e6e9c634ca75c07b

Preserve subagent capabilities independently of forked history (#52241)

## Why

Subagents should retain the spawning turn's selected skills and plugin choices whether `fork_turns` is `none` or `all`. Capability selection should not depend on copied conversation metadata.

## What changed

- Use a shared child startup path for fresh and history-forked agents, inheriting selected capability roots from the spawning environment snapshot.
- Pass the spawning turn's `disabled_plugin_ids` through both spawn handlers. When omitted, inherit the parent's current choices; explicit lists, including an empty list, override them.
- Resolve the parent before startup so inherited client MCP settings apply even when only the session source identifies the parent.
- Carry plugin choices into delegates with inherited isolation and preserve saved capability roots when resuming a child.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for executor skill listing and reading, plugin MCP registration with both history modes, plugin overrides, capability-root precedence and isolation, and restoring saved child settings after parent settings change.

GitOrigin-RevId: 2a6891a9bc6372fd2d1f30add2b5611f96b60594

Recover gRPC code-mode sessions after missing-session errors (#52235)

## Why

A host can reject a request for an unknown session while its lease streams remain open. Keeping that session binding prevents subsequent execution from recovering.

## What changed

Invalidate the session when `Execute` (including its response stream), `Wait`, or `Terminate` returns `NOT_FOUND`, allowing the next execution to open a fresh session. Return the failed call's error without replaying execution.

Document that these RPCs reserve `NOT_FOUND` for unknown sessions, while `CompleteToolCall` can use it for a missing invocation.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for recovery with lease streams still open, no replay of failed execution, and preservation of session state after `INVALID_ARGUMENT`. Add a cancellation-race test confirming that a late tool-completion `NOT_FOUND` leaves the session open.

GitOrigin-RevId: 85b38fdbd6d59268447b6aa6a85ea7c60ec869a7

Support request IDs in exec-server WebSocket handshakes (#52234)

## What changed

- Add optional `websocketRequestId` to `environment/add` and send it as `X-Request-ID` on direct WebSocket upgrades, including reconnects. It requires a secure transport or a loopback destination.
- Echo a supplied `X-Request-ID` in the exec-server WebSocket upgrade response.

## Testing

Add coverage for `websocketRequestId` serialization and for handshake header forwarding and echoing, both with and without a request ID.

GitOrigin-RevId: 235303ff7e1150405b7e1158d6024223144e0cc3

Honor API-key feature gates in TUI Daybreak selection (#52228)

## Why

API-key accounts could retain a saved Daybreak preference without `ApiKeyCyberAccessPrograms` enabled. Eligible API-key turns also omitted the `standard` access program when Daybreak was off.

## What changed

- Require both `CliDaybreak` and `ApiKeyCyberAccessPrograms` for known API-key accounts, and refresh Daybreak state when either flag changes.
- Use account eligibility consistently for normal turns, continuations, and background tasks so eligible API-key accounts can select the catalog's `standard` program when Daybreak is off.
- Preserve resumed preferences while account state is unknown and update `/daybreak` help to reflect API-key eligibility.

## Testing

Extend regression coverage for feature-flag combinations, API-key continuations, resumed preferences, and `/daybreak` help.

GitOrigin-RevId: 966f4789c9d685ff122da196a13da50c60a4b393

Include foreground activity in iTerm2 session status (#52226)

## Why

The iTerm2 session status reports `Working` without describing the current activity.

## What changed

Populate the OSC 21337 `detail` field from the TUI status header during foreground work, for example `Reading source`. Leave it empty for idle, waiting, background-only work, and the generic `Working` header.

Reuse terminal-title text filtering and the 240-character limit, then escape semicolons and backslashes for the status payload. Include detail in the emission cache so activity changes update the terminal even when the lifecycle state stays the same.

## Testing

Add coverage for foreground-only details, payload encoding, text filtering and truncation, and cache updates when the detail changes.

GitOrigin-RevId: b27a287b80e0db52be6cd9d5d246f03897e2996b

Fix config rebuild call in the Windows MXC preference test (#52225)

Remove the obsolete `default_zsh_path` argument from the call to
`Config::rebuild_with_session_layers` in
`local_mxc_preference_preserves_configured_backend` to match its current
signature.

GitOrigin-RevId: ddb7a73535cc605917971b974333d69bf3a92a93

Enforce application network policy for daemon updates (#52223)

## Why

Daemon updates must honor application network restrictions and stop when their configuration cannot be loaded.

## What changed

Activate the configured application network policy before creating the HTTP client for daemon updates and the PID update loop. Propagate configuration errors instead of falling back to a default HTTP client.

## Testing

Add tests for configuration error propagation and managed network requirements, covering denied and unlisted destinations as well as an allowed destination. Retain coverage for `features.respect_system_proxy`.

GitOrigin-RevId: 960485c7c57f34654402d7316cab9e0f66f24af3

Add configurable default plugin activation policy (#52220)

## What changed

Support `plugins._default.enabled` with explicit per-plugin `enabled` overrides. Omission preserves existing source and account enablement; configuration cannot activate a plugin disabled at its source. Plugin settings such as remembered tool approvals inherit the default unless `enabled` is explicitly set.

Apply the policy to plugin skills, MCP servers, Apps, and hooks, including selected executor roots and runtime configuration refreshes. Preserve the latest plugin policy when adding MCP dependencies and rebuild hooks when concurrent configuration updates replace their inputs.

Report effective enablement in `plugin/list`, `plugin/installed`, `plugin/read`, and `plugin/share/list`. Remote installation still installs disabled packages, but skips MCP and Apps authentication setup without writing an enablement override.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for default inheritance and explicit overrides, source-disabled plugins, policy refreshes during active turns, disabled or malformed selected plugin roots, and remote installation authentication behavior.

GitOrigin-RevId: 83b70c5b47fc95474fec292f248683f1f887221e

Enforce application network policy in standalone MCP commands (#52215)

## Why

Standalone MCP commands must honor `application.network` restrictions during OAuth discovery and login, even when the MCP server is allowed by its identity requirements.

## What changed

- Apply local network policy to cloud configuration bootstrap authentication and activate the effective policy on the loaded CLI configuration.
- Load `codex mcp add` through the shared cloud configuration loader and use its resolved `codex_home` when saving server configuration.
- Block disallowed OAuth discovery requests before connecting while preserving the ability to save a server when discovery is unavailable.

## Testing

Add isolated regression tests for blocked MCP discovery and login, discovery with network policy disabled, allowed and denied HTTPS destinations, and rejection of malformed managed network policy. Connection checks verify that denied requests never reach a TCP listener.

GitOrigin-RevId: f91401b51d6e6b9472bb01838f0d0903f83d62f3

Stop bundling patched zsh in Codex packages (#52213)

## What changed

Remove the patched `zsh` resource from package assembly and macOS signing, along with the `--zsh-bin` and `--zsh-manifest` packaging options.

Delete the standalone `codex-zsh` release workflow, build scripts, and DotSlash manifests. Update package documentation and layout and signing tests to match the remaining resources.

GitOrigin-RevId: 429a8db55048fed7facec89957910206523b6013

Expose Codex lifecycle status in iTerm2 sessions (#52203)

## What changed

Emit `Idle`, `Working`, or `Waiting` with colored indicators through iTerm2's `OSC 21337` session status protocol. Pending user action takes precedence over running tasks and background processes.

Limit emission to direct iTerm2 TTY sessions without a terminal multiplexer. Deduplicate successful writes, refresh status after terminal handoffs and resume, and clear status on suspension and exit.

## Testing

Add coverage for lifecycle transitions, protocol encoding, terminal detection, write retries, deduplication, and re-emission after terminal handoffs.

GitOrigin-RevId: 750e9ec92aeefc57651886a08ef6aea07675d175

Allow plugin toggles while searching and preserve filters on refresh (#52200)

## Why

In `/plugins`, Space edits a nonempty search query, leaving filtered plugins without the advertised toggle shortcut. Refreshing the popup also clears the query.

## What changed

- Add `Tab` to enable or disable the selected plugin while searching, and update toggle hints.
- Preserve the search query and selected plugin when the popup refreshes after a toggle.
- Give configured list bindings precedence over the `Tab` toggle and hide its hints when `Tab` is already bound.

## Testing

Add regression tests and snapshots for filtered toggles, search and selection preservation, and custom `Tab` binding precedence and hints.

GitOrigin-RevId: de98ba2bb3f9d8928ced7216dcc5e4b4fa4c4968

Track source attribution for individual context parts (#52195)

## What changed

- Add `ContentItemMetadata` to distinguish user input, developer instructions, `AGENTS.md`, skills, harness context, and tool-supplied context independently of message role and content classification.
- Keep attribution attached to content through prompt assembly, history processing, and hook-output spilling. Distinguish command hooks from MCP hooks and retain tool namespaces when known.
- Treat missing historical attribution as unknown and send per-content metadata only to Responses Lite.

## Testing

Update request and history assertions to cover attribution persistence and Responses Lite metadata handling.

GitOrigin-RevId: 24e56005f5bdb98bf82f2b3943f29c4c81f3d587

Enforce managed MXC requirements on Windows (#52193)

## What changed

Add `windows.require_mxc` to managed requirements. When set to `true` on Windows, reject configurations whose effective local sandbox backend is not MXC without changing the selected backend.

Validate after cloud configuration loads and outside startup recovery fallbacks. Apply the check to app-server startup and configuration loads, in-process bootstrap, session creation, sandbox debugging, and runtime configuration refreshes.

## Testing

Extend configuration tests to cover required and optional MXC selection, separately loaded policy requirements, and runtime refresh validation. Expand app-server startup tests to cover local and cloud MXC requirements, cloud preference selection, and failures without default-config recovery.

GitOrigin-RevId: 16456611bfd9df77e7f959b52515f1885b59ac75

Preserve side conversations across thread navigation (#52184)

## Why

Navigating to another thread discarded side conversations, preventing users from returning to them later.

## What changed

- Keep side conversations and their event listeners, channels, and pending requests across thread switches and session resets.
- Reopen a parent's existing side conversation with `/side` and submit any supplied question there. Resolve side toggles by the current thread's parent relationship.
- Limit explicit return-and-discard behavior to the active side conversation, and shut down retained side conversations when exiting.

## Testing

Extend regression tests to cover reopening a side conversation after navigating away, preserving its listener and pending approval during a reset, and restricting discard selection to the active side.

GitOrigin-RevId: ff80566970414ba190ff650d5e413ef63dc65449

Add optional descriptions to agent message board channels (#52183)

## What changed

- Accept an optional `description` in `create_channel` and return it in channel summaries so agents can describe a channel's purpose.
- Enforce a limit of 512 UTF-8 bytes and account for JSON escaping in the output budget before creating the channel.
- Store descriptions in both board backends and migrate existing SQLite databases, leaving older channels without descriptions.

## Testing

Add coverage for UTF-8 byte limits, serialization, output budgets, legacy database migration, and persistence after reopening. Update the model-context scenario to create and list a described channel before posting and reading a message.

GitOrigin-RevId: cf6f395944da23e238e078eefa5de201c8b9c197

Expose a verified sandbox launcher to local MCP servers (#52182)

## Why

MCP servers receiving sandbox state need a usable Codex executable to launch commands with the issuing call's policy. HTTP and remote servers cannot assume access to the host's filesystem.

## What changed

- Include optional `codexExecutable` metadata for local stdio servers when the host supplies an absolute, UTF-8 path to a CLI supporting `sandbox --sandbox-state-json`. Cache capability probes by executable path and bound them to five seconds.
- Document forwarding the sandbox state unchanged and requiring an explicit opt-out rather than silently falling back to PATH lookup or unsandboxed execution when the launcher is absent.
- Honor `useMxc` from forwarded sandbox state when selecting the Windows sandbox backend and network proxy policies, preserving a parent's selection made through CLI overrides.

## Testing

Add coverage for launcher eligibility across local, remote, and HTTP servers, invalid or missing executable paths, and binaries without sandbox-state support. Extend metadata integration and serialization tests to cover the optional launcher field, legacy state, and unknown future fields.

GitOrigin-RevId: ea8cd3770616e5a620b423a01052a7bc828bceb9

Strip symbols from source-built release package binaries (#52178)

## What changed

On Linux and macOS, strip the packaged copies of source-built release entrypoint and `codex-code-mode-host` binaries while retaining symbols in the original build outputs.

Add `--strip auto|all|none` and `--strip-tool`. The default `auto` preserves prebuilt inputs and other build profiles; `all` also strips those package copies, and `none` disables stripping. Select target-compatible strip tools and fail on missing tools or strip errors. Leave third-party resources unchanged.

## Testing

Add a regression test that compiles an executable with debug information, verifies stripped package binaries are smaller and still runnable, and checks that original inputs, preserved package copies, and third-party resources remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

GitOrigin-RevId: dc363c04690aa9e772690417a52a8eff31650278

Set a User-Agent for package archive downloads (#52177)

Send `User-Agent: codex-package` when downloading archives in
`scripts/codex_package/dotslash.py`.

GitOrigin-RevId: b12dc962b28d795704ba780b020fbf7ab91f5d50

Show AWS GovCloud guidance at startup and remember acknowledgment (#52176)

## Why

GovCloud guidance was tied to Bedrock credential setup, so users with an already configured provider could miss it.

## What changed

Check for GovCloud during TUI startup using the app server's resolved provider, including when connecting to a server. Require acknowledgment before proceeding and save `notice.hide_gov_cloud_guidance = true` to suppress the screen on subsequent launches. Quitting the guidance exits startup without saving acknowledgment.

## Testing

Add a terminal integration test covering acknowledgment persistence, quitting without saving, and suppression after restart. Retain coverage for explicit acknowledgment and scrolling in short panes.

GitOrigin-RevId: f09fd73a66fb02f94ebdd3c3b0dbe5712dfa9be7

Make environment context date and timezone configurable (#52164)

## What changed

Add `include_environment_context_time`, enabled by default. Setting it to `false` omits `<current_date>` and `<timezone>` while retaining the rest of the environment context, and skips the clock read used to populate the date.

## Testing

Extend configuration, session context, and external time provider tests to cover enabled and disabled time fields, context updates across turns, and current-time reminder behavior.

GitOrigin-RevId: 5071ce1701c044b680624d0cdbba7e0bc2b5bbe6

Remove the patched zsh shell execution backend (#52160)

## What changed

- Use the standard shell executor and remove the zsh fork escalation runtime, `codex-execve-wrapper`, and `shell-escalation` crate.
- Ignore `shell_zsh_fork` and `unified_exec_zsh_fork`, emit migration notices for legacy configuration, and warn when ignoring managed requirements for these flags.
- Keep the active session's `apply_patch` alias directory readable under restricted filesystem permissions.

## Testing

Add coverage for legacy configuration startup and shell execution, migration notice rendering, active alias directory selection, and nested `apply_patch` execution while other files in `CODEX_HOME` remain unreadable.

GitOrigin-RevId: 43af461fea32b4980550ee7237effd2bc0646ed8

Expose originating tool call metadata in command environments (#52119)

## Why

Command processes need thread and tool call labels for correlation, without stale values from inherited environments or cached shell snapshots.

## What changed

- Export the originating `exec_command` call ID as `CODEX_TOOL_CALL_ID`; later `write_stdin` calls leave it unchanged.
- Apply executor metadata as `CODEX_THREAD_ID` and `CODEX_TOOL_CALL_ID` after environment policies, overlays, and snapshot replay. Clear omitted fields when metadata is present; without metadata, preserve thread context and remove the call ID.
- Exclude both IDs from newly captured snapshots and omit the call ID from capture and validation helpers.
- Preserve empty call IDs, omit NUL-containing IDs, and handle case-insensitive environment names on Windows. Document that these labels support correlation, not authorization.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for metadata precedence, missing and invalid IDs, snapshot capture and replay, local and remote execution with pipes and TTYs, sandboxed remote execution, and preservation of the originating call ID across later input.

GitOrigin-RevId: 1027212b5d495d8e7cfac0f498c3134e060aa897

Fix idle cleanup for disconnected multi-agent v2 children (#52081)

## Why

Persisted multi-agent v2 children created after the client disconnects need lifecycle listeners so their runtimes can be released once idle. Listener attachment must also wait for an earlier runtime's cleanup to finish.

## What changed

- Start lifecycle listeners for persisted v2 children even when no initialized clients are connected, and defer attachment until pending unload cleanup completes.
- Keep ephemeral children loaded so follow-up tasks retain their model context.
- Raise the default `thread_unload_delay_secs` from 60 seconds to 1800 seconds (30 minutes), updating the configuration documentation and sample.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for children spawned after disconnect with zero- and one-second unload delays, including waiting for pending cleanup, keeping running threads loaded, releasing idle runtimes, and preserving an ephemeral child's earlier reply across a follow-up. Update configuration tests for the new default and explicit overrides.

GitOrigin-RevId: 2fecc77b5c03237aa8fd7eacc4bd119b99d36e0a

Require assessment text in the Guardian parser (#52065)

All callers already check that an assessment payload is present before parsing it. Change `parse_guardian_assessment` to accept `&str` instead of `Option<&str>` and remove its redundant missing-payload check.

Update the callers and existing parser tests to pass text directly.

GitOrigin-RevId: e4fb4bf7aca5b20f25f5b27300ce9a6f22c97939

Add scenario coverage for worker context across idle eviction (#52062)

## What changed

Add a scenario test that queues a message for an idle worker, evicts it, and resumes it with `followup_task`. Assert that the same worker is reloaded and that queuing mail and eviction do not start another model turn.

Snapshot the complete parent and worker request histories and the resumed worker's mailbox to verify that earlier context and unread mail survive eviction in order.

GitOrigin-RevId: 2d0f7c63a2221df9c3d7e378eecaf14b8441d2b9

Run Guardian conversation classifiers concurrently and preserve action order (#52061)

## Why

A conversation classifier waiting for preparation or full response completion can block newer classifications. Concurrent reviews also need to prevent a later action's evidence or low-risk score from being reused for an earlier action.

## What changed

- Run conversation classifications independently, forking the latest compatible completed history from an earlier action. Only a valid completion with a newer action index can replace retained history.
- Keep admission and observation ordering atomic, and hold capacity permits through full response completion.
- Reject cached low-risk scores from later actions for tool-linked approvals, including initial approval checks.
- Track originating tool-call IDs separately from approval display IDs, preserving stdin write provenance and excluding synthetic MCP elicitation IDs from tool ordering.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for delayed preparation, capacity admission, out-of-order completion, cancellation, invalid retained output, and history snapshots. Exercise pending approval ordering in both `snapshot` and `conversation` modes, and verify linked and unlinked MCP elicitation provenance.

GitOrigin-RevId: 097476ccb3b8718369a69f55c3c39132f7f1a4c1

Cover instant interruption in steered-input persistence tests (#52048)

## What changed

Extend `steered_input_checkpoint_controls_next_request` to cover user input with `InstantInterrupt` enabled under both background and synchronous checkpoint policies. Keep the original response gated until the follow-up request arrives to prove that interruption advances the turn while preserving checkpoint ordering.

Explicitly disable `InstantInterrupt` for user-input cases that wait for response completion, and enable it for the tool-output case to verify that tool outputs still wait for completion and synchronous persistence.

GitOrigin-RevId: d39544ce6f5ad83489fd8a80b1e731a64c7a876c

Add regression coverage for cancelled agent reloads (#52040)

## What changed

Add `cancelled_v2_send_finishes_reload_registration` to verify that cancelling a multi-agent V2 send during an evicted child's reload does not cancel registration. The test checks that the thread-created notification arrives and evicted-environment state is cleared.

Evict and reload the child again with only one child slot available to catch leaked residency pins or reservations, and verify that only the subsequent follow-up message is delivered.

GitOrigin-RevId: ce6ed90d0049245370f26d8dbb35b9f1cd0b3063

Preserve agent state when unloading idle multi-agent v2 children (#52034)

## What changed

- Route app-server idle unloading of multi-agent v2 children through local eviction that preserves unread mail and environment selections for reload.
- Hold residency pins through input submission so newly reloaded children cannot be evicted before receiving their work.
- Guard listener cleanup against replacement runtimes and subscriptions, and reject local eviction of host-controlled threads.

## Testing

Add coverage for unsubscribe-driven eviction followed by `followup_task`, verifying restored conversation context and exactly-once delivery of queued mail. Extend tests to check that residency pins block eviction and that rejected host eviction preserves the thread and mailbox.

GitOrigin-RevId: e36723730af683d2081e495e637f0e6d23548b8d

Log Windows sandbox availability and backend selection (#51974)

## What changed

Record local MXC availability and the selected Windows sandbox backend at app-server and session startup. Log the backend again when an accepted session settings update changes the Windows sandbox level, using a blocking task for the log write.

Selection entries distinguish `mxc`, `disabled`, `unelevated`, and `elevated` in the sandbox logs under `.sandbox` in Codex home.

## Testing

Update the remote thread persistence assertion to allow the `.sandbox` directory on Windows, since startup logs are not thread persistence artifacts.

GitOrigin-RevId: 4130b59ac7761223775ac9b6afb096abb7fb4615

Attribute compaction analytics to the correct voice session (#51963)

## Why

Roll back stale Guardian reviews before reusing reviewer history (#51683)

## Why

Authorization updates during a pending Guardian approval can invalidate its decision. Retries need the updated guidance without inheriting the invalidated review or losing earlier valid context.

## What changed

- Validate authorization while the reviewer is reserved, before publishing its history checkpoint.
- Roll back stale attempts to the last committed review, preserving earlier valid reviews across repeated invalidations.
- Pin the issuing action's repository instruction snapshot for reviewers and retries, avoiding fresh instruction discovery through disconnected executors.
- Treat stale authorization as a request for a new review rather than a failed decision.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for repeated approval invalidation, retention of earlier valid context, exclusion of stale decisions, and execution of the pending action exactly once. Extend the disconnected-executor test to verify that retries retain repository instructions and use updated authorization.

Persist Guardian review failures for reports across restarts (#51651)

## Why

- Persist failed-review records in SQLite before reviewer cleanup, retaining at most 64 records globally, eight per thread, and 8 MiB of evidence. Delete persisted evidence when its reviewed thread is deleted.
- Recover and deduplicate persisted and in-memory records for the reported task tree when uploading `auto-review-failures.jsonl`.

Distinguish thread listing failures from exhausted history (#51602)
